base: official_24h: same57 pairs, original3x,6 slots,5bps fills,24h deadline
scope: Examine all61 campaigns including14 losses. Existing history already observed; all new controls exploratory, not independent OOS. No profit-picked coin/tag removal.

controls.stop3: Hard stop3% adverse price from first filled entry; both directions; adds cannot move stop away; actual engine intrabar stop and gap rules, exit veto overridden for risk stop.
controls.stop6: Same hard stop6%, fixed coarse sensitivity, not a parameter sweep.
controls.stale12: After12h exit a campaign only when total P&L including partial realized exits and fees is negative. Still24h unconditional cap.
controls.trendgate: Only enter longs when lastclosed own4h EMA12>EMA200 and close>EMA200; shorts mirror. No forward candles. Existing exits and24h cap unchanged.

diagnosis: Closed5m campaign ledger paths, MAE/MFE,6h/12h P&L, entry own/BTC closed4h features; compare winners as well as losers
validation: Real Freqtrade full unified-wallet replay, floating drawdown, original losses saved, maxholding<=24h, path/accounting reconciliation. Record costs, errors and failed variants. July-Aug and Sep-Oct are descriptive time splits only.

adaptive_control.rationale: Original loss-path diagnosis showed positive unrealized gains subsequently reversed. Explicitly post-diagnosis exploratory hypothesis.
adaptive_control.rule: Closed5m favorable first-entry price move>=2%; thereafter original first-entry price plus0.15% long /minus0.15% short protective stop; current-open gap exit if newly armed protection already crossed. No initial hard stop. Not a guaranteed whole-campaign breakeven after DCA/fees.
adaptive_control.name: risk_profitprotect

risk_scaling_control.name: official_1x_24h
risk_scaling_control.rule: Same57-pair24h control at1x for all three leverage modes; measure absolute risk reduction, not signal improvement.

overheat_hypothesis.name: risk_overheat80
overheat_hypothesis.rule: lastclosed own4h RSI14>=80 blocks long; <=20 blocks short; otherwise original24h behavior
overheat_hypothesis.selection_warning: Explicitly added AFTER diagnosing OP/XRP entry RSI83.6/88.9 and observing no baseline long winner>=80. Uses conventional80/20 but has in-sample selection bias. Cannot call validation/OOS or robust optimum.
